_comment: Solo stratum for ASICs. Every miner gets its own coinbase: 97.5% to the address it authorises with, 2.5% to solo_fee_address. Nothing is credited to the TIDES window and nothing is owed after the block - the payout is the block. prime_port 0 keeps this instance standalone, so it cannot disturb the pooled gateways or Prime.
_vardiff_comment: Same ladder as the pooled ASIC port (:23334). Box firmware reports an optimal range around 1164-6985, so 4096 is inside it from the first share, and vardiff still climbs 4x per eight shares to the 131072 cap (~140 TH/s at one share every four seconds). Share difficulty does not affect a solo payout at all, only the share rate and the hashrate readout.
